channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: Minneapolis is giving Americans the model for fighting a fascist regime
item.description: The day when they can turn their resistance against the regime into electoral power, take back control of the legislative branch, and start using the powers of Congress to hold this criminal regime accountable.

item.title: Federal arrest of Don Lemon intensifies alarm over press freedom under Trump Justice Department
item.description: The journalist was taken into custody after covering a Minnesota church protest and after a judge rejected an initial attempt to charge him.

item.title: Deaths in Minnesota drive rebellion against ICE funding as Sanders demands leadership purge
item.description: After U.S. citizens were killed by federal agents, lawmakers tie DHS money to accountability and warn of authoritarian enforcement.

item.title: Trump demands $10 billion from IRS over tax leak as conflict concerns deepen
item.description: The lawsuit targets federal agencies Trump oversees and revives scrutiny of his finances, IRS security failures, and enforcement rollbacks.
